hooks.news: Riverfarm saw the Runner Ryoka Griffin off on the solstice morning, and a stranger from the road walked her to the edge of the fields.

canon_ref.note: Day 95 at Riverfarm is a guess (user choice): 3.41 has her arrive on the night before Christmas and the Interlude has her leave the day after. The rules: enter no house unasked, ask no favours, make no bargains, tell no lies, be behind stone and iron by deep night.

b4.riverfarm_says_goodbye_to_ryoka.summary: The day after Christmas, the solstice, Riverfarm sees Ryoka off after breakfast. Prost says the village owes her. Anabelle wants to be a Runner. Yesel gives her a knitted scarf, and Ivolethe says to take it: on the solstice a gift must not be refused. Ivolethe lays down the day's rules.

canon_ref.note: One gives the name Tamaroth; the other two (a scholar with a book, a man who moves like a dancer) are unnamed. Nothing links them to any other NPC. Erin drops the coin in Lyonette's jar.

b4.erin_turns_down_three_gifts.summary: Erin wakes alone at dusk and builds up the fire. Three strangers come in from the storm and eat with her. They offer three gifts for her soul: an umbrella of sunlight, a hangman's rope and a bone horn. She tries each, blows the horn, then gives them all back. They vanish and leave a white coin.

canon_ref.note: The horn in the dark follows Erin's horn in the text; the book does not say it is the same, so no flag links them. No fae or mortal magic works there.

b4.ryoka_refuses_the_dead_at_the_fire.summary: Lost in a wood that loops back on itself, Ryoka makes a fire. Three dead things come to share it and offer their hands. Ivolethe bites her awake and is blown away. Ryoka hears a horn, feeds her potions to the fire, and is handed her own lost fingers. She says no and runs with a burning stick.

canon_ref.note: The woman is probably Ivolethe in a greater form (guess). The riders are not named; do not call them the Wild Hunt.

b4.riders_hold_back_the_dark_for_ryoka.summary: When her torch dies, a tall woman with a shining sword runs beside her while shining riders charge past and hold back the dark. Ryoka breaks out into the midnight snow. The scarf has a hand shape burned into it; she burns it and her fingers, and runs on toward Invrisil.

hooks.news: On the solstice dawn the Wandering Inn's kitchen was bare, but a Human guest had already cooked for everyone who came home.

canon_ref.note: The dawn is the start of day 97. Erin thinks of it as a kind of New Year. End of Book 4.

b4.friends_come_home_at_the_solstice_daw.summary: Late that night Lyonette, Mrsha, Zel and the three adventuring teams wake Erin. Every scrap of food in the kitchen is gone, so they run to Liscor for more. Erin finds the coin was real. The snow has stopped and two moons show as the sun comes up.
